lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，我往前飞。
lines.en: Wings opening and closing, I fly on.
I rise and dip with no fixed line.
I curve around a clump of grass.
One beat, then a glide.
I settle on a white tulip.
The wind nudges me off course.
I fly low to the ground.
I fly back to this patch of flowers.
I go from flower to flower.
The rings on my wings flash.
I fly so lightly I barely sound.
I pick a well-opened bloom.
I fly along the sunlight.
The plain is wide. I fly where I like.
I have flown many places today.
I rest a moment on a grass tip.
I rest on a petal.
I close my wings, then open them.
The higher the sun, the livelier I am.
Sunlight rests on my wings.
There are plenty of flowers on this plain.
I am in no hurry. The flowers will not leave.
My antennae tap the air.
A little pollen is on my wings.
I live a long while.
When the wind stops, I go quiet.
There is not much danger here.
I slowly groom my wings.
You are standing right where the sun was.
I lift my head from the petal.
I can see that net in your hand.
The rings on my wings are conspicuous.
You are standing very close.
Once I fly, you cannot catch me.
Your hands are very large.
I am resting in your shadow.
Is that a net in your hand.
I will rest still for now.
I shoot up a block higher.
A few scales of powder came off.
I fly on, sinking all the while.
My wings are too heavy to lift.
I drop into the grass, wings still spread.
That landed heavily.
I try to right myself.
The flower was knocked down.
I fly much more slowly now.
Stop hitting me.
White tulips? I like those.
Does that flower have much nectar?
I edge closer to that flower.
That smell is right.
I only recognise this one kind.
Do not shake that flower.
I settle at the petal's edge.
Sweet. Really sweet.
Holding it in your palm will not help.
When I finish this one, I go.
I spun twice before I steadied.
Some powder came off my wings.
I steady myself, wobbling.
I fly low, so I am easy to hit.
I swerve around your shoulder.
That left me a little dizzy.
I settle back on the petals.
Do not wave your hand at me.
I take off again.
Pardon me, and thank you.
I wait on the flower.
Two of us, circling together.
Our wing colours match.
The eggs go on a leaf.
These leaves are tender enough.
I circle her, round and round.
Do not fly too far.

lines.zh: 我们一起落在同一朵花上。
lines.en: Let us settle on the same flower.
You need not hurry.
This is a good day.
I press it with my front legs.
This is not a flower.
I land on it and sniff.
This does not taste good.
I flew off at once.
Too heavy to carry.
There is a little sweetness on it.
I nudge it.
There is no nectar here.
I perch at the edge and look.
Something is blocking the light.
I lift my wings.
Let me fold my wings down.
That looks dangerous.
I am ready to fly.
Do not swat.
I hide behind the flower.
My eyes see it clearly.
Any closer and I leave.
I am reckoning how far off you are.
I keep watch.
That shadow keeps covering me.
I moved to another flower.
My wings are ready to launch.
I fly up a little.
The wind helps me hide.
It is still watching me.
I shift slowly.
I hold still and let it move first.
I am about to fly.
I bump against your hand.
My wings fan across your face.
That is all I have.
I cannot keep this up for long.
That costs me a lot.
I only want to drive you off.
I drew back a little.
I settle back on the flower.
Do not swat again.
Let me catch my breath.
A small butterfly lands on a flower.
Rings upon rings on my wings.
I come out of the daylight.
I lift off over the plain.
The petal swayed a little.
I settle on a blade of grass first.
There are enough flowers here.
My life is long.
I land on the tallest bloom.
I spread my wings.

lines.zh: 火苗烤得我的翅边发焦。
lines.en: The flames singe the edge of my wing.
I drop out of the air.
Water wraps my wings.

lines.zh: 我被掀得翻着跟头落地。
lines.en: I tumble through the air before landing.
Something passed through my wing.
This light lost me my direction.
No flowers, and I weaken.
The thunder knocked the flowers down.
There is not one flower here.
